evidence: All four approved source kits: dense sampled original-clip OBB SAT, preserved per-style head-stress limitations, immutable source GLB hashes and common texture-independent body/rig/animation fingerprint verified at import

clearance_method.sampling: Uniform 1000 Hz plus every authored glTF key time, both endpoints included
clearance_method.interpolation: glTF LINEAR translations/scales; shortest-path quaternion SLERP with normalized-linear near-angle approximation (quaternion dot > 0.9995); complete hierarchy and inverse bind matrices
clearance_method.geometry: Per-cuboid 15-axis separating-axis theorem (OBB vs OBB); no coarse whole-hairstyle bounding box
clearance_method.margin_definition: Minimum across time and cuboid/body pairs of maximum normalized SAT separating-axis gap. Positive is a conservative lower bound on surface separation, not exact Euclidean distance. Negative means penetration; its magnitude is the minimum translation along the tested SAT axes to separate a pair. Values within 1e-8 m are treated as contact.
clearance_method.excluded_body_part: Head/scalp overlap is intentional and reported separately in head-local coordinates
clearance_method.limitation: Dense sampled animation verification, not a continuous mathematical guarantee; no native Blockbench playback performed by this validator

head_stress_method.grid_degrees: Yaw -35..35 and pitch -15..15, inclusive at 1 degree increments; combined 2201 poses per base pose
head_stress_method.rotation_order: Existing head local rotation, then yaw about local +Y, then pitch about local +X (R_head @ R_yaw @ R_pitch)

runtime_head_look: No independent head-look is added by the native runtime. Authored clip rotations remain unchanged; no corrective deformation, extra rig, hidden animation adjustment or runtime angle clamp is used.
limitations: Sampled evidence only, not a continuous mathematical guarantee
Intentional scalp overlap is excluded from torso/limb clearance
All original-clip margin values below are source meters; multiply by 0.9 for native meters
The wide yaw ±35 degrees / pitch ±15 degrees stress grid covers neutral and held crouch only, not every animation sample

Long loose curls and half-up curly cascade fail the wide head-look stress grid; their smaller yaw ±20 degrees / pitch ±5 degrees grid passes only at neutral and held crouch, not throughout animated motion

Twin braids fail the wide head-look stress grid and a separate yaw ±10 degrees / pitch ±5 degrees grid composed with sampled walk/crouch; do not add independent head look for this style based on these reports
Rigid head attachment only: no hair physics or independent braid/pigtail motion
Native clip and idle/walk blend SAT tests are finite sampled regressions and do not establish arbitrary blend or added head-look clearance
The tightest dense source original-clip margin is twin braids during walk: 0.00614054400040373 m source, 0.005526489600363357 m native

method.grid_degrees: Yaw -20..20 and pitch -5..5, inclusive at 1 degree increments; combined 451 poses per base pose
method.rotation_order: Existing head local rotation, then yaw about local +Y, then pitch about local +X (R_head @ R_yaw @ R_pitch)

long_hair_reduced_grid.limitation: Neutral and held crouch only; this is not an all-animation or continuous-motion head-look envelope

twin_braid_composed_grid.method: Existing clip sampled at 100 Hz plus every key time, composed with 15 combinations: yaw -10,-5,0,5,10; pitch -5,0,5; R_head @ R_yaw @ R_pitch. Sampled result only, not continuous guarantee.

native_sampled_regression.body_parts: torso, two arms and two legs; intentional scalp overlap excluded
native_sampled_regression.method: Reconstruct each full cuboid from triangle corners and face normals, transform with the production sampler, compare all hair/body cuboid pairs using normalized 15-axis OBB SAT
native_sampled_regression.original_clips: All five clips: 121 uniform times including endpoints, plus every authored key, with duplicate times removed
native_sampled_regression.idle_walk_blends: 1,377 sample_blended poses: 9 idle phases over [0,3), 17 walk phases over [0,0.8), 9 blend weights including endpoints
native_sampled_regression.limitation: No independent head-look; finite grid only, no continuous or arbitrary-blend guarantee

measured_results.margin_array_order: Appearance/material hair IDs 1 through 13, in ascending numeric order
measured_results.units: native meters, with the production uniform 0.9 scale already applied
measured_results.limitation: These measurements cover only the stated finite grids and supplied geometry/animation; positive margins do not establish continuous, arbitrary-blend or added-head-look clearance
